Want a quick way to preview what is inside your parquet file, the live app is embedded below.

```{=html}
<div class="app-embed-wrapper">
  <div class="app-embed-toolbar">
    <span class="app-embed-label">⬡ Parquet File Viewer</span>
    <div class="app-embed-links">
      <a href="https://ar-puuk.github.io/parquet-viewer/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="Open in new tab">
        ↗ Open app
      </a>
      <a href="https://github.com/ar-puuk/parquet-viewer" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="View source on GitHub">
        ⌥ GitHub
      </a>
      <button class="app-fullscreen-btn" onclick="toggleFullscreen(this)" title="Toggle fullscreen">⤢ Fullscreen</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="app-embed-frame" id="app-embed-frame">
    <iframe
      id="spatial-sql-iframe"
      src="https://ar-puuk.github.io/parquet-viewer/"
      title="Spatial SQL Explorer"
      allowfullscreen
      loading="lazy"
    ></iframe>
  </div>
</div>

<style>
.app-embed-wrapper {
  border: 1px solid #2a3f57;
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 1.5rem 0 2rem;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
  background: #0b0f14;
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
}
.app-embed-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  background: #0f1419;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #1f2d3d;
}
.app-embed-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f0a500;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.app-embed-links {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
.app-embed-links a {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #6b8099;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color 0.15s;
}
.app-embed-links a:hover { color: #f0a500; }
.app-fullscreen-btn {
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #6b8099;
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid #2a3f57;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s;
}
.app-fullscreen-btn:hover { color: #f0a500; border-color: #f0a500; }
.app-embed-frame {
  width: 100%;
  height: 600px;
  transition: height 0.25s ease;
}
.app-embed-frame.fullscreen {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  height: 100vh !important;
  z-index: 9999;
  border-radius: 0;
}
.app-embed-frame iframe {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: none;
  display: block;
}
</style>

<script>
function toggleFullscreen(btn) {
  const frame = document.getElementById('app-embed-frame');
  const isFullscreen = frame.classList.toggle('fullscreen');
  btn.textContent = isFullscreen ? '✕ Exit' : '⤢ Fullscreen';
  document.body.style.overflow = isFullscreen ? 'hidden' : '';
  if (isFullscreen) {
    // Allow ESC to exit
    const handler = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { toggleFullscreen(btn); document.removeEventListener('keydown', handler); }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', handler);
  }
}
</script>
```


If you work with data and want a quick way to preview the contents of a `.parquet` file, give it a try. The code is on [GitHub](https://github.com/ar-puuk/parquet-viewer) — issues and PRs welcome.
